verdict.rationale: Apify supports building custom Actors using Crawlee/Playwright/Puppeteer/Cheerio-based scrapers, which inherently allow CSS/XPath selector-based extraction, but the evidence pack contains no direct documentation or example showing CSS/XPath selector configuration for field extraction. missing for 10: explicit docs/example of defining CSS or XPath selector rules for field extraction, dedicated selector-based Actor templates, independent confirmation of selector extraction accuracy.
